text:
Hello everyone! My wife and I are new to this group, but are soon immigrating back to Israel and would love some tips.

I am a british citizen and my wife is Israeli, so she doesnt need anything new (our marriage is already registered legally in israel, it was a 3-4 month process). I know I need to have essentially every document i’ve ever had to my name, but what documents need to be apostilled? I know my birth certificate needs it, but im not sure if anything else needs it. Maybe the background checks? 

I am looking forward to hearing from some other british spouses on any tips they have on how to do this all! ❤️

Happy to be a part of the group ❤️
